<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the dominant ion at m/z ≈ 199 corresponds to a protonated molecule containing a single bromine atom (the M and M+2 peaks are of nearly equal intensity, characteristic of Br). Subtracting the monoisotopic mass of Br (≈ 78.918 Da) from the neutral mass (~ 198 Da) leaves a fragment of ~ 119 Da, which fits the composition C₈H₇O (96 + 7.055 + 15.995 ≈ 119 Da). Adding the bromine gives the molecular formula C₈H₇OBr, which matches the observed isotopic pattern and mass. 

The required format is CxHyOzX, so the answer is C8H7O1Br.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H7O1Br</final_answer>
